note: The High untrusted-expression path (`github.head_ref` in `git push`) was judged overstated: a fork pull_request run gets a read-only token and its `head_ref` checkout fails before the injection, so an outsider runs shell with a read-only token at most, Medium.

ceilings.pending: an untrusted expression whose outsider-controlled part (`github.head_ref`) exists only under the pull_request trigger is credited with the `contents: write` token of the push trigger, although a fork pull_request run is read-only.
